title: SteamServerAdmin — Per-Server Configuration Schema
description: Schema for a single Steam game server configuration file. Place one JSON file per server in config/<server_name>.json.

server_id.description: Unique identifier for this server instance (snake_case, e.g. 'novaforge_eu1').

name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the dashboard.

app_id.description: Steam AppID of the dedicated server (e.g. 896660 for Valheim, 380870 for ARK).

install_path.description: Absolute or relative path where SteamCMD installs the server files.

branch.description: Steam beta branch to install from (e.g. 'public', 'staging').

launch_args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the server executable at launch.

executable.description: Path to the server executable relative to install_path (auto-detected if omitted).

restart_schedule.description: Cron expression for scheduled automatic restarts (e.g. '0 4 * * *' = 4 AM daily). Leave null to disable.

update_schedule.description: Cron expression for scheduled automatic updates (e.g. '30 3 * * 0' = 3:30 AM every Sunday). Leave null to disable.

restart_warning_minutes.description: Minutes before a scheduled restart to broadcast a warning message to connected players.

auto_restart_on_crash.description: Automatically restart the server process if it exits unexpectedly.

max_crash_restarts.description: Maximum consecutive crash restarts before the supervisor gives up and alerts the admin.

health_rules.description: AI-driven log threshold rules. Each rule defines a log pattern and the action to trigger.

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match against live log lines.

threshold.description: Number of matches within the window before the action fires.

action.description: Action dispatched when the threshold is exceeded.

permissions.description: Role assignments. Keys are Steam IDs or usernames; values are role names.

whitelist.description: Steam IDs or usernames allowed to connect (empty = open to all).

notifications.description: Optional notification channels for events (restarts, bans, permission changes).

log_path.description: Path where this server writes its own log files (used by the log-tail ingestion pipeline). Relative to install_path if not absolute.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for grouping servers in the dashboard (e.g. ['novaforge', 'eu', 'test']).
